description: Source code implementing the Keccak-1600 permutation and related functions for cryptographic hashing, specifically for SHA-3 and SHAKE algorithms, as part of BoringSSL's cryptography library.

methods.name: keccak_f
methods.description: Performs the Keccak-1600 permutation on the state array, implementing the θ, ρ, π, χ, and ι steps across 24 rounds.

methods.name: keccak_init
methods.description: Initializes the Keccak context with input data, setting up the state for hashing based on the specified configuration (SHA3-256, SHA3-512, Shake128, Shake256).

methods.name: BORINGSSL_keccak
methods.description: Performs the full Keccak hashing process, producing output of specified length from input data.

methods.name: BORINGSSL_keccak_init
methods.description: Initializes the Keccak context with input data for subsequent squeezing.

methods.name: BORINGSSL_keccak_squeeze
methods.description: Extracts output bytes from the Keccak state, performing permutation as needed.
